items.item_text: 2 years of administrative support experience in a healthcare, medical office, ambulatory care, or patient service environment.
2 years experience with patient registration, appointment scheduling, insurance verification, referrals, and authorization processes.

We are seeking a highly organized and patient-centered Surgery Coordinator to coordinate all aspects of surgical coordinating for ophthalmologists in our Orbital and Ophthalmic Plastic Surgery (Oculoplastics) clinic and ensuring a concierge-level patient experience. Responsibilities include, but are not limited to:
Coordinate and schedule patient surgical and laser procedures for assigned faculty physicians
Schedule required pre-operative testing and appointments
Verify patient insurance coverage and obtain necessary prior authorizations
Serve as a patient liaison, guiding patients through the pre- and post-operative process
Maintain accurate documentation and patient records within the electronic medical record system
Provide general clinic and administrative support as needed to ensure smooth daily operations
Ability to communicate effectively both verbally and in writing using proper grammar and professional etiquette.
Ability to prioritize tasks, exercise sound judgment, work independently with minimal supervision, and adapt to frequent interruptions in a fast-paced environment.
Ability to multitask while maintaining accuracy, confidentiality, and attention to detail.
Working knowledge of medical terminology, insurance benefits, referral processes, and authorization procedures.
Ability to verify insurance eligibility, obtain authorizations, and communicate financial responsibilities to patients.
